title.title: Kinetic limits over the whole regular Boltzmann lifespan
title.subtitle: Claim: gases with stable radial potentials follow Boltzmann for as long as its solution stays regular

plain: Many particles bumping like billiard balls: for how long does a smooth averaged equation describe them?

object.axisLabel: time, schematically; $T$ = as long as the Boltzmann solution stays regular

beats.text: How long do particle dynamics provably follow the Boltzmann equation?
Deng, Hani and Ma reached the whole regular lifespan, for hard spheres only

steps: Follow particles in whole interacting clusters, not single collisions
Expand over those clusters, allowing brief attractions
The expansion holds while Boltzmann's solution stays regular
